(1) appleDevMac in appledevloop_darwin.go now calls luahost.DevMacOSPostprocess when cfgBool(cfg,"mac_dev_rename",true) is true, renaming/re-signing before install (rename-then-install ordering, matching Python's `_installer(_rename(built_app))`); appPath is reassigned to DevMacOSPostprocess's returned dest and used for the launch that follows. (2) apple_darwin.go adds appleResolveMacDevProductName/appleResolveMacDevProcessPattern/appleMacDevIsRunning/appleMacDevKill (ported from admin_lib/apple.py's _resolve_mac_dev_product_name/_resolve_mac_dev_process/_make_mac_dev_running_check/_make_mac_dev_kill); appledevloop_darwin.go builds isDevRunning/killDev once via these and uses them in place of the old appleProcessRunning/appleKillProcess calls at every call site in the dev loop (kill-before-build, wait-for-appeared, running-check, kill-on-exit). (3) docs/architecture/lua-host-api.md's 'Deliberately NOT ported' section and apple_darwin.go's package doc comment both had the mac-dev-rename and is_running_fn/kill_fn bullets removed and replaced with a paragraph confirming they are now ported and wired into appleDevMac (admin-3rgp.75), keeping App Store Connect device registration and log pruning as the remaining, correctly-still-listed gaps. Ran `go build ./...` (darwin, since these files carry the darwin build tag) — clean, no errors. Ran `go vet ./...` — clean. Ran `go test ./internal/kinds/...` — passed (`ok ... 16.172s`); one run in the middle of this session hit `TestMakeKillPortClearsARealHolder` failing on a port-timing race, confirmed unrelated and flaky by rerunning it alone 3x (all pass) and rerunning the whole package immediately after (clean pass) — that test lives in killport_test.go, untouched by this diff. Wrote a scratch _test.go exercising the new pure functions (appleResolveMacDevProductName default/override/empty-process, appleResolveMacDevProcessPattern's three branches: install-path override, mac_dev_rename=false build-products path, default renamed-bundle path, and appleMacDevIsRunning's always-false fallback with no process) — all 3 tests passed against the real code. Restored the original code, deleted the scratch test file, and confirmed `git diff --stat HEAD` matches exactly what it was before (same 3 files, same line counts) and `go build`+`go test ./internal/kinds/...` pass clean on the restored tree. No live macOS project with a real Xcode scheme/mac_dev_rename config was available in this environment to drive an actual `admin dev` mac loop end-to-end (would need a signed .app target, a real launchable binary, and Finder/process observation) — the pure-function unit+mutation testing above and full package test suite are the closest verifiable surface reachable here; a real end-to-end run is unreachable from this environment, not evidence against the change.
